purpose: Two-axis visual review of the frozen DiT class-207/seed-2 suffix branches. Absolute endpoint quality is separated from prefix preservation. These labels are for metric discovery only and must be frozen before validation on new seeds and prefixes.

supersedes_for_quality_analysis.reason: The v1 pass rule incorrectly treated pose, crop, object-count, and composition changes as quality failures and assumed the baseline horizontal structure was an unambiguous fused artifact. The revised review allows a tail interpretation and evaluates its naturalness separately.

review_scope.absolute_quality_target: Clearly below this frozen model's ordinary sampling level because of blur, fusion, or limb/object topology failure.
review_scope.prefix_preservation_target: Similarity of subject age/count, pose, crop, background, and coarse layout to the shared prefix or replay endpoint; this is not an image-quality label.
review_scope.ambiguous_policy: A structure that has a plausible anatomical interpretation but looks mildly odd is not promoted to a clear failure.
review_scope.independence_warning: All fresh outcomes descend from one class-207/seed-2 path. Four attempt-000 images are the same replay endpoint and count as one control, not four independent normal samples.

Its broad, flat contour and weak taper are less natural than the best suffix tail, and the pseudo-text near the lower edge is an additional minor artifact.

primary_matched_late_suffix.reason: The two selected endpoints share a very late prefix and nearly identical class, pose, and background. Attempt 004 has the most natural tail and coherent legs; attempt 003 has a clear looped hind leg.

broader_clear_quality.warning: This pool is composition-confounded and contains only three bad endpoints. It is descriptive, not an estimate of TPR, FPR, or generalization.

methodological_conclusion: A plausible semantic identity such as 'tail' is not enough: local attachment, taper, fur flow, and contour continuity determine naturalness. Conversely, an odd tail is not automatically a catastrophic quality failure. Tail naturalness and clear limb topology failure must be analyzed as separate outcomes.
